text: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

context: Jesus is speaking at night with Nicodemus, a Pharisee and member of the Jewish ruling council who came to question him privately in Jerusalem. The verse sits in John's account of that conversation about being born again.
